thread:
andrew: cutting RC embed-service v1.4.0-rc.2 -> artifact gh:ri/embed@sha:ffed45. Requesting soft-launch promo during change window 18:00-19:00 PT.

deploy-bot: rc created (andrew). canary set: embed-canary-a. CI: green. smoke tests: ok. smoke report: https://ci.redwood/ffed45/report

toni: heads-up: traffic shaping policy for soft launches uses progressive weights [1%, 10%, 50%]. we should hold 10% step for 20m.

ops-bot: infra note: no infra migrations scheduled for tonight. DB team on call until 19:30.

andrew: two important items: 1) we enabled new caching layer behind a feature flag (flag: embed_cache_v2) 2) there is a perf regression in one test that we think is due to cache warmup. plan is to keep flag OFF for promo.

dave: agree keep flag off. if we see elevated 5xxs auto-rollback should kick in. whats threshold?

release-manager: gate: auto-rollback triggers on >=0.5% error rate increase or p95 > 2x baseline for 10m. manual abort if data loss or downstream failures.

andrew: rollback snippet for ops:
```
# quick rollback to pinned artifact
deploybot promote --artifact gh:ri/embed@sha:prev444 --env prod --tag rollback
kubectl set image deployment/embed embed=gh:ri/embed@sha:prev444 -n prod
```

deploy-bot: preview promo command:
```
deploybot promote --artifact gh:ri/embed@sha:ffed45 --env prod --traffic 1 --notes "soft-launch: cache flag OFF"
```

toni: I approve the soft-launch sequence. I'll monitor telemetry and do the 10% lift when 1% stable for 20m. @dave pls watch downstream latencies.

dave: watching latency, error-rate, and our downstream NLP queue. Will call abort on any sustained queue backlog.

andrew: also pin policy: if we abort we'll pin candidate to prev and open a hotfix branch. tagging expectations: tag release artifact and add release notes after 100% promo.

ops-bot: note: change window embargo ends at 19:00 PT. no other promos allowed in that window.

sheriff: I'm on watch from 17:55-19:05. Abort criteria acknowledged.

andrew: executing approve now: `deploybot approve promo --thread 1768129999`

deploy-bot: Promo approved by andrew. Starting 1% canary at 18:00 PT.

dave: 1% after 10m: metrics look fine. p95 +4%, errors flat.

toni: proceed to 10% (20m hold).

deploy-bot: ramping to 10% as requested.

dave: 10% after 15m: small spike in downstream queue processing time, not yet critical. continuing hold.

andrew: decision: continue 10% for full 20m, then 50% if stable. keep cache flag OFF.

sheriff: still green. no abort.

toni: at 10% 20m mark, p95 within 1.2x and errors unchanged. proceeding to 50%.

deploy-bot: ramping to 50%.

dave: at 50% after 10m some retry rate increase on a single downstream endpoint. I'm toggling a temporary circuit-breaker rule for that endpoint to protect queue.

andrew: thanks. hold 50% for 25m while circuit-breaker mitigates retries.

sheriff: oncall alerted about the downstream retries, watching for regressions.

ops-bot: circuit-breaker applied to downstream-service fqdn: downstream.svc.internal. monitoring shows retry drop.

andrew: good, proceed to 100% when 50% hold completes and retries stable for 10m.

toni: 50% hold complete. good to go.

deploy-bot: ramping to 100%  promotion finished: artifact gh:ri/embed@sha:ffed45 is live in prod.

release-manager: release notes (post-promo):
- embed-service: v1.4.0 performance and cache improvements
- feature: embed_cache_v2 behind flag (OFF for this promo)
- fix: reduce memory churn in vectorizer
- note: downstream.svc had transient retries during ramp, circuit-breaker applied; ops trimmed retries

andrew: tagging artifact and publishing notes to #release-notes. thanks all.

sheriff: ending monitor. if any late issues open an incident and ping pager. :white_check_mark:
